Klasse Planet

java.lang.Object
greenfoot.World
Planet
public class Planet extends greenfoot.World
The main world of the game. It controlls the generation of the world and the relevant actor objects. Additionaly it controlls the game logic and propability of events.

    • Planet

      public Planet()
      Creates a new world with a size of 26x17 cells with a cell size of 50x50 pixels although the movement is undependent of the cell size. It also instanciates the Rover objects for each player
